findings.title: Pre-send persistence failure leaves an unresolvable Sending receipt
findings.impact: Same-ID retry stays pending although no provider request was sent; host restart recovers.
findings.next: Classify failed durable intent without implying an outstanding provider acknowledgement; preserve no-replay behavior.

findings.title: History capacity disables Stop and current-request replies
findings.impact: At 10000 operations an owned active turn cannot be interrupted or its current approval declined, while capabilities remain advertised.
findings.frequency: Boundary forced with seeded historical receipts; organic frequency not measured

findings.title: Windows state replacement has a remove-before-rename interval
findings.confidence: High for code order; runtime recovery unknown
findings.next: Windows fault injection in the replacement interval.

findings.title: Container publication precedes its smoke verification
findings.confidence: High for workflow order; external partial-release outcome not tested
findings.next: Disposable-registry/workflow rehearsal that fails after push; no public publication.
